# Alliance Media Pty Ltd

> Alliance Media Pty Ltd ("Alliance Media") is an Australian film production company based in Melbourne, Victoria. It is the international arm of the Alliance group and the sister company of Alliance Productions India LLP (Mumbai). Alliance Media produced the award-winning short film Echoes of Us and is developing the international feature Defiant Nadia.

Website: https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/
Contact: ash@allianceproductionsindia.com · +61 478 625 638 · Melbourne, Australia

## Films
- Echoes of Us (short film, English) — directed by Joe Rajan; produced by Pooja Batra and Alliance Media Pty Ltd; starring Deepak Tijori, Iulia Vantur and Alessandra. 88+ international laurels: 15 Best Film, 22 Best Actor, 12 Best Director, 11 Best Actress. Best Actor (Founders Award) at the French Riviera Film Festival, Cannes 2026; screened at the 79th Cannes Film Festival; SAIFFF Florida 2026 sweep; Indian Panorama triple honour; 11th Dadasaheb Phalke Awards sweep. https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/films/echoes-of-us/
- Defiant Nadia (upcoming international feature, in development) — based on true events; directed by Deepak Tijori; written by Atiq Rahimi; produced by Alliance Media Pty Ltd (Indian arm: Alliance Productions India LLP). https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/slate/

## People
- Deepak Tijori — Founder & Managing Director. Internationally awarded Indian actor-filmmaker; Industry Advisor, West Australian Indian Film Council (WAIFC) Industry Advisory Council. https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/people/deepak-tijori/
- Arshdeep Singh — Executive Director (Melbourne). Co-producer of Echoes of Us; runs production, packaging, financing and festival pipeline for the group's international slate. https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/people/arshdeep-singh/
- Snehal Kulshreshtha — Director, PR & Global Outreach. https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/people/snehal-kulshreshtha/
- Anita Sharma — Co-Producer, Creative Producer & Music Director. https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/people/anita-sharma/
- Chirag Trivedi — Chief Financial Officer (CPA Australia; Principal & Partner, Holistic Business Developers, Adelaide). https://alliancemediaptyltd.au/people/chirag-trivedi/
